en.title: br
en.summary: This is the letter L334 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The letters br
paragraphs: The letters br make one blend in English. You hear this sound at the start of (brown) /braʊn/, which means the dark color of earth. This letter pair has one sound in English.

sections.title: How to say br
paragraphs: First, close both lips to block the air. Turn your voice on and release the lips. Next, pull the tip of your tongue back toward the roof of your mouth. Do not let your tongue touch the roof. Touch your throat with your hand to feel it shake.

sections.title: When to use br
paragraphs: The letters br always make the same sound everywhere. You hear it at the start of (brick) /brɪk/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with br
paragraphs: Do not roll your tongue or tap the roof of your mouth. Keep the tongue pulled back and still. Do not add a vowel sound between the lips and the tongue. Move smoothly from the first sound to the second without stopping the voice.
